summary: Frontend-only re-test of the three iteration_78 defect fixes in AttackGraphTab.jsx plus the 12-invariant regression sweep. Tested live on the preview URL as admin@nivxray.com against the dense incident inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd (12 activity nodes / 11 edges / primary_path 6 in this projection), Attack Graph tab -> ACTIVITY GRAPH sub-view. RESULTS: (1) HIGH empty-state fix VERIFIED — unchecking all 7 layer toggles now yields counter '0/53 nodes · 0/42 edges' AND a rendered <g data-testid=xdr-ag-empty> containing 'NO EVIDENCE-BACKED ATTACK CHAIN' + 'Governed evidence is insufficient to plot a chain. Turn on the Gaps layer to see UNKNOWN pivots, or ingest more Endpoint / Identity / Cloud telemetry.' (screenshot captured); the guard is now `visibleNodes.length === 0` and the rect width falls back to (layout?.width||800)-40 = 760. (2) MEDIUM label fix VERIFIED — all 12 node primary labels are <=15 chars (max observed 15: '185.199.108.201'; 'inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd' now renders as 'inc_r36_edr_5…'), every label's right edge is 41-73px INSIDE the 156px rect, and measured label/finding-badge overlap is 0px on all 6 badge-bearing nodes. (3) LOW edge hit-area fix NOT EFFECTIVE — the transparent wide hit path is present and correct (every edge <g> has exactly 2 paths, hit path is FIRST, stroke='transparent', stroke-width=12, data-testid=xdr-ag-edge-hit-{id}), but hit-testing the same 6 edge midpoints still gives only 2/6 (unchanged from iteration_78, target was >=5/6) and real mouse clicks on those midpoints still select a NODE in 4/6 cases. REGRESSION: all 12 previously-green invariants still pass (see details). ZERO console errors throughout.

ui_bugs.issue: LOW/MEDIUM — the iteration_78 LOW fix does NOT resolve the defect. The transparent 12px hit stroke was added INSIDE the same edge <g>, which is still painted BEFORE all node groups (verified SVG child order: defs, xdr-ag-edge-*, …, xdr-ag-node-*). Widening a stroke does not change z-order, so node rects continue to occlude the edge midpoints. Measured: midpoint elementFromPoint -> 'rect' inside a node group for 4/6 sampled edges (blockers: xdr-ag-node-ip:7ad82b8a1, xdr-ag-node-signature:32, xdr-ag-node-hash:e5f6505, xdr-ag-node-event_id:b92); 9-point path sampling gives only 2/9, 2/9, 3/9, 2/9, 7/9, 8/9 points on the edge; real mouse clicks selected the edge 2/6 (identical to last run). The hit stroke DOES help where the edge is not occluded (a point 5px off the centreline resolves to EDGE on the 2 unoccluded edges), so it improves tolerance but not occlusion. Fix options: (a) render a SEPARATE top hit layer — a second visibleEdges.map() emitting only the transparent stroke paths AFTER the nodes block, carrying the same onClick/onMouseEnter (cap strokeWidth ~8 to limit node-click shadowing), or (b) route edges around node rects (orthogonal routing through the inter-column gutter) so the centreline never crosses a node.

issues: Labels are now hard-truncated at 13 chars + ellipsis, so distinct entities can become visually identical (e.g. 'powershell.ex…' for the process vs 'powershell.ex…' for the commandline node, both visible in the same viewport). Recommend adding a <title> hover tooltip with the full label on the primary-label <text> so the analyst can still read the untruncated value.
Pre-existing (unchanged): node footer '● OBSERVED' + '· ev N' at 8.5px in #94a3b8/#a3906a on near-black fills remains borderline low contrast.
Pre-existing (unchanged): on this dense incident 6/12 nodes carry the amber primary ring + glow, so primary-path dominance is diluted.

action_items: MEDIUM: the edge hit-area fix must move the transparent hit paths into a top-most layer rendered AFTER the nodes block (or reroute edges around node rects). The current in-group hit stroke changes nothing because z-order, not stroke width, is the cause — still 2/6 edge midpoints selectable.
NICE-TO-HAVE: add <title>{n.label}</title> (or an aria/title tooltip) to the node primary label now that truncation is 15 chars, so full identifiers stay discoverable.
critical_code_review_comments: AttackGraphTab.jsx is 1253 lines — still far past the 700-line guideline. The layout engine, edge renderer, node renderer, LegendSwatch, replay controls and the edge inspector pane are cleanly separable.

Hit-testing in an SVG scene graph is governed by document order, not stroke width. The added hit path is a sibling of the visible stroke inside the same <g>, so both remain under every node group. Any 'wide hit stroke' must be emitted in a layer after the nodes.
KIND_TONE is still hand-maintained alongside NODE_ROLE + ROLE_TONE (17 duplicated mappings) and is only consumed by the legend — derive it instead.

success_rate.frontend: 2/3 targeted fixes verified; 12/12 regression invariants pass. Verified live: node rect 156x46 rx=3 on all 12 nodes; node fills restricted to #0b1220/#0b1a2c/#1a1408 (no rainbow); data-node-role in {context,telemetry,activity} on every node; data-edge-class on all 11 edges {causal, evidence}; every non-primary causal edge has marker-end=url(#nx-arrow-causal); 6 primary nodes all have filter=url(#nx-primary-glow) + #fbbf24 ring; non-primary context anchors all render style opacity 0.82 while telemetry/activity stay 1; progression banner with the exact 'Evidence-backed causal chain — correlation NEVER implies causality' rider; legend swatches causal(dash 0 + arrow)/evidence(0,no arrow)/correlation(5 3)/gap(2 4) plus all 12 EDGE_SEMANTICS rows; single [xdr-ag-inspector] (0 role=dialog) populating on node click; all 5 Path Replay controls present and 'next' advances 0/6 -> 1/6 with the replay focus ring; [xdr-ag-metrics] footer renders 7 metrics.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep link is /xdr/incidents/inc_r36_edr_514098d418dd?tab=attack_graph (UNDERSCORE in tab value) then click [data-testid=xdr-ag-subview-activity]. Empty state repro: uncheck all 7 [data-testid=xdr-ag-layer-*] inputs — xdr-ag-empty now renders (do NOT use locator.inner_text on it, it's an SVG <g>; use page.evaluate/textContent). Finding-count badge testid is xdr-ag-finding-badge-{nodeId}. For edge hit-testing use path.getPointAtLength + getScreenCTM then document.elementFromPoint; note the edge <g> query [data-testid^=xdr-ag-edge-] also matches nothing extra since the hit path testid xdr-ag-edge-hit-* is on a <path>, not a <g>.
rca_of_the_issue: Edge hit area: SVG hit-testing follows document (paint) order — the topmost painted element under the pointer wins. The fix added a transparent stroke-width=12 path as the FIRST child of each edge <g>, but all edge <g> elements are still emitted before all node <g> elements in the SVG (confirmed: children = defs, xdr-ag-edge-*, …, xdr-ag-node-*). Edge centrelines are routed straight from src.x+156 to dst.x, which passes through intermediate node columns, so a node rect is painted on top of the (now wider) hit stroke at 4/6 sampled midpoints and elementFromPoint returns that rect. The stroke width only widens the catchable band in regions where NO node overlaps — which is why off-centreline sampling improved on the 2 already-unoccluded edges but the occluded 4 are unchanged. Remedy: emit the transparent hit paths in a dedicated <g> AFTER the node block, or reroute edges around node bounding boxes.
